hero.heading: Get in Touch

contactDetails.serviceArea: Serving all areas across Hyderabad & Secunderabad

form.successMessage: Thank you! We'll get back to you within a few hours.

fields.servicePlaceholder: Which service are you interested in?
fields.messagePlaceholder: Tell us about your requirement (location, type of property, etc.)

items.question: Do you offer a free site visit?
items.answer: Yes — we visit your property at no charge to measure and assess the area before giving you a quote.

items.question: How quickly can you install?
items.answer: Most installations are completed within 1–3 days of your inquiry, depending on the service and location.

items.question: Do you cover all areas in Hyderabad?
items.answer: Yes — we serve all areas across Hyderabad and Secunderabad, including Banjara Hills, Gachibowli, Jubilee Hills, Kondapur, Madhapur, Hitech City, and more.

items.question: What warranty do you provide?
items.answer: All our installations come with a warranty. The duration depends on the product — ask us when you call for details.
